inventory.visualPurpose: Elastin stretch-relax cycle with desmosine cross-links
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Single elastin molecule shown stretched and recoiling with lysine-derived desmosine cross-link sites; contrast with rigid collagen triple helix

notes: The collagen pipeline is an original KYP redraw preserving every source station (fibroblast nucleus, Gly-X-Y preprocollagen, RER hydroxylation with vitamin C, glycosylation, triple helix, Golgi, exocytosis, C/N-terminal cleavage, self-assembly, lysyl-oxidase cross-linking with copper) plus the source's disease annotations (scurvy, osteogenesis imperfecta, Menkes). The elastin stretch-relax figure is a KYP adaptation preserving the source's relaxed/stretched conformations, fibrillin scaffold, lysyl-oxidase cross-links, and the elastase/α1-antitrypsin axis.
